import bpy, json
from mathutils import Vector
scene = bpy.context.scene
dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
records = []
for obj in sorted(scene.objects, key=lambda o: o.name):
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    ev = obj.evaluated_get(dg)
    mesh = ev.to_mesh()
    try:
        mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
        records.append({'name': obj.name, 'vertices_world': [list(ev.matrix_world @ v.co) for v in mesh.vertices], 'triangles': [list(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles], 'polygons': [list(p.vertices) for p in mesh.polygons], 'modifiers': [{'name': m.name, 'type': m.type} for m in obj.modifiers]})
    finally:
        ev.to_mesh_clear()
print(json.dumps({'scene': scene.name, 'unit_system': scene.unit_settings.system, 'scale_length': scene.unit_settings.scale_length, 'meshes': records, 'instance_count': sum(1 for x in dg.object_instances if x.is_instance)}, ensure_ascii=False))

import bpy, json, math
from mathutils import Vector
scene = bpy.context.scene
dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
summary = []
for obj in sorted(scene.objects, key=lambda o: o.name):
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    ev = obj.evaluated_get(dg)
    mesh = ev.to_mesh()
    try:
        mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
        vv = [tuple(ev.matrix_world @ v.co) for v in mesh.vertices]
        tt = [tuple(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles]
        deg = []
        for i,t in enumerate(tt):
            a,b,c = (Vector(vv[j]) for j in t)
            if (b-a).cross(c-a).length_squared == 0:
                deg.append({'triangle_index': i, 'vertices': [vv[j] for j in t]})
        summary.append({'name':obj.name,'vertex_count':len(vv),'triangle_count':len(tt),'polygon_sizes':sorted(set(len(p.vertices) for p in mesh.polygons)), 'aabb_min':[min(v[k] for v in vv) for k in range(3)] if vv else None,'aabb_max':[max(v[k] for v in vv) for k in range(3)] if vv else None, 'degenerate_triangles':deg,'small_geometry':{'vertices':vv,'triangles':tt} if len(tt)<5 else None,'modifiers':len(obj.modifiers)})
    finally:
        ev.to_mesh_clear()
print(json.dumps({'unit_system':scene.unit_settings.system,'scale_length':scene.unit_settings.scale_length,'meshes':summary,'instance_count':sum(1 for x in dg.object_instances if x.is_instance)},ensure_ascii=False))

import bpy, json, math
scene=bpy.context.scene
readout=[]
for o in scene.objects:
    if o.type!='MESH': continue
    m=o.data
    vs=[tuple(sum(float(o.matrix_world[i][j])*float(v.co[j]) for j in range(3))+float(o.matrix_world[i][3]) for i in range(3)) for v in m.vertices]
    tris=[tuple(p.vertices) for p in m.polygons if len(p.vertices)==3]
    deg=[]
    for ti,t in enumerate(tris):
        a,b,c=[vs[i] for i in t]
        u=[b[i]-a[i] for i in range(3)]; v=[c[i]-a[i] for i in range(3)]
        n=(u[1]*v[2]-u[2]*v[1],u[2]*v[0]-u[0]*v[2],u[0]*v[1]-u[1]*v[0])
        if all(x==0 for x in n): deg.append(ti)
    d={'name':o.name,'vertices':len(vs),'polygons':len(m.polygons),'triangle_count':len(tris),'nontriangles':[p.index for p in m.polygons if len(p.vertices)!=3],'bounds':[[min(v[i] for v in vs),max(v[i] for v in vs)] for i in range(3)],'degenerate_triangles':deg,'nonfinite':any(not math.isfinite(x) for v in vs for x in v)}
    if len(vs)<=3: d['world_vertices']=vs; d['triangles']=tris
    readout.append(d)
print(json.dumps(readout,ensure_ascii=False))

readout = {'scene_name': scene.name, 'unit_system':scene.unit_settings.system, 'scale_length':scene.unit_settings.scale_length, 'meshes':[]}

    if obj.type != 'MESH':
